name: Emaar Properties PJSC
summary: Emaar Properties PJSC, a prominent international real estate enterprise headquartered in Dubai, UAE, leverages its subsidiaries to specialize in property investment, development, and comprehensive development management. The company's operations are structured into three main divisions: Real Estate; Leasing, Retail, and Related Activities; and Hospitality. The Real Estate segment focuses on creating, marketing, and managing a diverse portfolio of properties, including condominiums, villas, commercial units, and undeveloped land. The Leasing, Retail, and Related Activities division is responsible for developing, leasing, and overseeing shopping malls, as well as various retail, commercial, and residential spaces. Meanwhile, the Hospitality segment develops, owns, and/or manages hotels and serviced apartments, also encompassing leisure-related ventures. Beyond these core business areas, Emaar provides a range of additional services such as shopping mall and retail management, general hospitality services, property management, and utility services. The company further diversifies its portfolio by investing in financial service providers and engaging in entertainment activities. Emaar was founded in 1997.
